## Overview
== Tracking and ads overview
action  3 things are still on = Switch it all off -> Switch it all off <shield>
info    Advertising = 1 still on <shield>
info    Tracking = 2 still on <shield>
## Blocking
== Ad and tracker blocking
choice  Blocking = Ads & telemetry -> Change (confirms) {3 values} <shield>
info    Custom ad blocking = No list <shield>
== System updates
toggle  Block TV software updates = Allowed [off] -> Turn on <shield>
## LG ads
== LG ads and promotions
toggle  All LG ads and promotions = Off [off] -> Turn on <shield>
toggle  Screen saver ads = Off [off] -> Turn on <shield>
toggle  Sponsored tiles on Home = Off [off] -> Turn on <apps>
toggle  Recommendations on Home = Off [off] -> Turn on <shield>
toggle  Ads while watching = Off [off] -> Turn on <shield>
toggle  Smart tips = Off [off] -> Turn on <shield>
toggle  Smart tips in Settings = Off [off] -> Turn on <shield>
## Tracking
== Screen content recognition
toggle  Live Plus = On [on] -> Turn off <shield>

info    Capture = Stopped <shield>
== Advertising identifier
toggle  Limit ad tracking = Off [off] -> Turn on <shield>
